sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Top Secret is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Now look who we have here. Do you even know what's going on in the city right now? Relax, nobody knows. But you and I are gonna start investigating. First, we gotta find out what air deliveries were made and by whom, things like air deployments before the chaos emerged. Also, that plane that got shot down in the woods is still bugging me. Find me the intel of this kind. I'll hook you up with a general direction so you don't hit a dead end. There was an active radar station at the Lighthouse island. It must have all the intel we need. After that, I'll take the lead. Oh, also, not a word to anyone about this, okay? It's shady stuff, you know what I mean."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse
- Locate and obtain the military HDD with archived flight routes
- Hand over the drive

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 28,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.75
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Golden neck chain
- 1× Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine
- 1× 5.56x45mm M856A1 ammo pack (50 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase for Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine at Skier LL3
- Unlocks purchase for AR-15 Magpul MOE Carbine stock (Black) at Skier LL3
"Fuck's sake, it's all encrypted. Need to call the four-eyes again. Alright, you've done your part of the deal as agreed. I'll figure something out what to do with this crap."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Radar station commandant room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse. |
| Working hard drive | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player does not plant the item and fails to extract with it, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find a HDD which can be found in the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse. A Radar station commandant room key is needed to enter it. The radar station is located at the lighthouse peninsula territory. The commandant's office is located on the first floor, recognizable by a red sign. The HDD is located on a desk in the back of the room.
